title: PostgreSQL CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY (paraphrase)
text: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY builds an index without taking a lock that blocks writes, at the cost of more total work and a longer build. It cannot run inside a transaction block, and if it fails it can leave an invalid index that must be dropped and rebuilt.
